from kb_test_request_presets p left join ks_enum_categories ecf on ecf.category = 'model_family' and ecf.is_deleted = 0 left join ks_enum_configs ef on ef.category_id = ecf.id and ef.item_code = p.model_family and ef.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
select
and ( p.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.remark like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and p.protocol_code = #{protocolCode}
and (p.model_family = #{modelFamily} or p.model_family is null)
order by p.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_test_request_presets(code, name, protocol_code, model_family, request_body, remark, status) values(#{code}, #{name}, #{protocolCode}, #{modelFamily}, #{requestBody}, #{remark}, #{status})
mapper.update:
update kb_test_request_presets
name = #{name}, protocol_code = #{protocolCode},
model_family = #{modelFamily}, request_body = #{requestBody}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status},
where id = #{id}
